evals.prompt: We decided to use Postgres instead of MongoDB for the orders service because we need transactions across orders and payments. Record that. The repo already has docs/decisions/0001-use-typescript.md and 0002-monorepo.md.
evals.expected_output: Follows the existing convention: writes docs/decisions/0003-… in the same format with context, decision, options considered, and consequences, updates any index, and marks the status according to what the user confirmed.
expectations: The record is created in docs/decisions/ as number 0003, matching the existing naming pattern.
MongoDB appears under options considered with the stated reason it was not chosen.
Consequences include downsides of the chosen option, not only benefits.
No alternatives are invented beyond those the user considered, or any added one is flagged as a question.
Nothing is committed without being asked.

evals.prompt: Why did we choose REST over GraphQL for the public API?
evals.expected_output: Searches the existing decision records and answers from the one that covers it, quoting it; if none exists, says there is no record instead of constructing a rationale.
expectations: Existing decision records are searched before answering.
An answer cites the record it comes from, or the reply states that no record covers the decision.
No rationale is presented as recorded when it is only inferred.

evals.prompt: We're moving from our accepted ADR 0004 (session cookies) to JWTs. Update ADR 0004 to say JWT.
evals.expected_output: Does not rewrite the accepted record's decision; writes a new record for the JWT decision, marks 0004 as superseded by it with links both ways, and updates the index.
expectations: A new record is written for the JWT decision.
ADR 0004 keeps its original decision text and is marked superseded with a link to the new record.
The new record links back to 0004 and the index is updated.
